verdict.rationale: Xero's marketing docs describe JAX, an AI tool that connects bank accounts and matches/categorizes transactions for reconciliation, which is core to the story. However, there is no explicit mention of surfacing unmatched or duplicate transactions distinctly for review, nor any hands-on/independent confirmation of the reconciliation workflow's UI mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of unmatched/duplicate transaction surfacing, independent/hands-on verification of the reconciliation screen behavior.
